title: Set up projects in Chat
summary: Your selected agent can now guide a project from its first questions to reviewed setup files, all inside Chat. Mac verification, clearer connections, and faster, steadier chats and terminals round out the release.

highlights.title: Project setup, guided by your agent
highlights.body: Start in Project Chat, answer focused questions, add Skills or connections, review the generated guidance, and save only when you are ready.

highlights.title: Verify work on your Mac from Chat
highlights.body: Run approved terminal checks or verify supported Electron changes from a private worktree Chat. Results return to the same conversation, and the Mac menu bar lets you follow or stop active work.

highlights.title: Connect Apps, organized
highlights.body: Connected tools, available connections and the app gallery now appear in clearer groups. Connect Apps is also available through Matrix Core when you need it in Chat.

items.text: Sent Chat messages appear immediately, and the first reply stays visible when a new Chat opens.
Terminal commands keep their final output after they exit.
Terminal windows switch and stream faster, while slow workspace recovery no longer holds up the rest.
Default Matrix apps no longer offer new sharing, and Web shows one clear Share entry for apps you create.
Apps you have not checked for collaboration now show as not checked instead of unavailable.
Managed Codex sessions can use code mode reliably.
Sign-in actions stay in the correct browser tab when more than one Matrix page is open.
Funded AI requests no longer get stuck when a new month begins.
Browser works on standard 2 GB Matrix computers and reports setup problems more clearly.
SSH connection updates verify the same computer before saving changes.
